text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even feeling like this,
I still managed to make the board.
choice_data_list: This is the result of all your accumulated efforts.
This is the result of all the effort you've put in.
Let's try to stay as positive as possible for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Are you trying to say
that I'm building up true strength?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That kind of thing...
Even if I get stronger... in the end, it's just the same.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No way, obviously.
If you really want to get me motivated, then—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I know I need to change my mood,
I know. I really do, but..."
